title: Bayer ships HIV-contaminated hemophilia medicine abroad

tellings.quote: you go just back to the 80s where they knowingly shipped a massive amount of hemophilia medications that were infected with HIV into third world countries.

plain: In the 1980s, a drug company, named here as Bayer, knowingly shipped large amounts of hemophilia medicine infected with HIV to poor countries. A guest named Brigham Buhler brings this up with Michels as part of a talk about the drug industry's dark past and human experiments. He tells it as a sign of how far such companies will go.
